detail.description: A private, off market opportunity in Campbells Bay. A modern four bedroom home with two bathrooms and a double garage, moments from the beach and reserve in one of the North Shore's most tightly held coastal suburbs. Available to qualified buyers by negotiation. Register your interest with Harrison to arrange a confidential viewing.
